This is the complete release version of Kangoku Senkan 2, including 2 bonus afterstories with all-new scenario, CGs and animation!
Enjoy beautiful CGs in higher quality! It's updated to 1024x768 size from the previous 800x600 screen.
You can toggle Anime mode and CG mode anytime during the play!

Secretly train the female general Alicia who is feared as the demon of Cordelia and the imperial princess Maya and turn them into convenient female pigs!
Even under the effect of brainwashing, they try to resist with sheer force of will.

Story
In the solar system, there is a cold war going between Neo Terras (Group of the Earth) and New Soral (Group of space colonies).
There is a neutral third party known for its strong military power: Cordelia is a fortified city which is constructed on a satellite planet off Uranus. There, renowned general Alicia Viewstream and the imperial heir Maya Cordelia decided to build an alliance with New Soral.

The main character, Dino Dirasso, is a secret agent sent from Neo Terras. His plan to prevent the alliance is radical: making use of the secret brainwashing lab in the new battleship called Yekel, he's going to brainwash and destroy the two women!

* Who will you betray to the interests of Neo Terras? Alicia or Maya?
As the plot unfolds you your choices will affect the story. Which woman will you deliver to the enemies of fortified city?
Can you be victorious against these strong women, who resist even in their brainwashed states?!

* Switch between Daily lifestyle and Brainwash time!
Enjoy two phases with Alicia and Maya, daytime is "normal", nighttime is "brainwashed".
Take action both times to thoroughly transform their personalities...

Staff
Planning and original story: Sasayama Ittousai
Art: Kagami
Scenario: Sonoda Masaki
Director: Sasayama Ittousai

# Release 3.1 // 26.01.2019


No donations // no ad-maze // no upfront payment
If you paid for this, you were scammed!
If you like the game, please [buy it](https://dlsoft.dmm.co.jp/detail/illusion_0022_pack/) (~.~)v
If you enjoy the mods, please consider donating to the modders on patreon where possible.

### This pack is made with a base consisting of the following:

--> Base Release Game
--> Studio additional disk
--> VR Functionality update
--> Additional content Expansion Pack
--> The latest official update os of 11.03.2018 (no more recent official update).

### IF YOU'RE MOVING FROM ANOTHER REPACK:
I don't recommend just extracting this over another repack, due to potential conflicts. Please extract this to its own folder and move over your chara, cap, studio and save folders.

### What's planned for the future?

--> Generate missing preview files (A lot of mods ship without preview images).
--> Redo already existing preview images as to secure visual consistency.
--> Adding new mods, if I can locate any more.

### Do you want to help?

--> Translation
I have tried my best to translate clothing mods that were originally in Japanese or Chinese, but due to my complete lack
of knowledge about the Chinese language and lacking knowledge with regards to the names of different articles of clothing,
it's far from perfect. The Chinese translations are heavily dependant on Google Translate, and several of the mods are
named rather unhelpful even then, so if you have a good grasp on the Chinese language, or are well versed with regards to
clothing names, please feel free to contact me on discord (@ScrewThisNoise#3544) or on any location where I share my repack
(Anime-Sharing/Hongfire/Nyaatorrents).

--> Missing Mods?
I am a one man show, so there's a limit to my knowledge regarding where to find mods, though I do my very best to do so, so
it's quite likely that I've missed several mods that you may know about. See the included '[BR] Modlist.csv' file for a
detailed list of all included clothing mods, and the credits list for a list over included plugins, and feel free to contact
me about including new mods or plugins in future releases.
